target: Every origin departure and intermediate designated timing-point departure exactly on time; every terminal arrival no later than published; no missing trips. Zero tolerance.
qualification: No complete calibrated matrix. Diagnostic, superseded, bus-only and single-seed results cannot qualify a production proposal.

omitted_old_overlays.evidence: The official outbound 701 shape and frozen OSM route relation 10107392 both continue from way 966302094 to 477791560. OSM way 477791560 has oneway:bus=no and already imports a bus-capable contraflow edge.
omitted_old_overlays.limits: Bus-only connector in both baseline and proposal. Ordinary traffic retains the imported right-turn restriction. This does not establish legal current street permissions.

limitations: Urban road speed capped at 50 km/h, preserving lower imported limits; unverified signage.
Crossings imported from frozen OSM; sidewalk guesses are inferred, not surveyed.
Signal phases, yellow (3 s) and all-red (2 s) are generated assumptions, not municipal timing plans.
Known Porto signal equipment points do not establish controlled movements.
Independent scheduled workings; no observed vehicle blocks.
